title: Variant-aware onboarding pipeline and runtime smoke validation for community weights
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build an end-to-end onboarding pipeline that preserves and publishes multiple compatible runtime variants for community models. The pipeline must accept a weights bundle, run conversion into supported runtime formats (float16, int8/quantized, and a sparse-aware variant), run deterministic validation and a lightweight runtime smoke suite against representative prompts, generate pin recommendations for the catalog, and publish a versioned performance profile. The goal is to automate variant generation and ensure the first-pin published to the catalog is safe for serving and has baseline latency/throughput telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline accepts a signed weights bundle + manifest and produces at least one validated runtime artifact for each targeted variant (fp16, q8_0, sparse-compat)
Automated conversion produces deterministic checksums and a conversion log stored with the artifact manifest
Runtime smoke executes in a controlled staging runtime and reports latency (p50/p95/p99), memory footprint, token throughput, and token-level KV cache correctness for a canonical prompt set
Pin recommendation algorithm emits a primary pin and two fallback pins with metadata (model_id, commit, variant, quantization, hardware profile) and a confidence score
Published performance profile includes standardized metrics, sample prompts, and a fail/review flag when safety checks or hallucination rate exceed thresholds
End-to-end run is triggable from a PR or UI and generates a report + links to artifact storage, conversion logs, smoke-run traces, and candidate pin for review
tasks: Design conversion container image and CLI for deterministic conversion (owner: ENG - infra) - DONE
Implement variant config generator (supports fp16, q8_0, sparse-compat) - IN PROGRESS
Integrate deterministic checksum step and provenance metadata into manifest - TODO
Build lightweight runtime smoke harness that runs on staging runtime and collects latency/throughput/kv-correctness - IN PROGRESS
Add pin recommendation service hook and store candidate pin in catalog staging table - TODO
Wire UI approval flow in Console for publish/reject of recommended pins - TODO
Create e2e test that runs on nightly cadence with a known OSS model to validate pipeline stability - TODO
notes: We intentionally keep the smoke suite lightweight (~30s per variant) to avoid long blocking runs in the PR gate.
Sparse-compat variant is a compatibility build that uses masked kernels; if conversion fails, pipeline should continue and mark variant as unavailable rather than aborting entire run.
Pin confidence is computed from conversion success, smoke metrics passing thresholds, and similarity of token distributions to known benchmarks.

Security review required due to execution of third-party weights; runtime runs must be sandboxed and network egress blocked during conversion and smoke steps. KMS access restricted to publish step only.
